title: jmri-json-signalMast-client-message
description: Schema data object in message from client to JMRI for type "signalMast"

userName.description: If present, set the user name of the signalMast

comment.description: If present, set the comment for the signalMast; null clears it

state.description: If present, set the aspect of the signalMast, or "Held" to hold it

lit.description: If present, set whether the signalMast is lit

held.description: If present, set whether the signalMast is held
